Name: Syu' Smallrooms for PIF
Author: Syuchinikurin
Description:
目前做了四个房间，之后可能会在这里继续更新。文件夹中每个对应房间包含一段无声的占位BGM，可以替换为任意音频文件，或在不需要背景音时删除content里的数据。
如果在使用着色时出现问题，或者发现图层错误，请告诉我。如果在装修时觉得某些地方多一个或少一个格子会更合适，也可以告诉我，我会制作差分版本。
装饰封面是朋友做的，不要问我家具来源。
Currently, four rooms have been made, and future updates may be added here.
Each room’s folder includes a silent placeholder BGM, which can be replaced with any audio file, or removed from the content if no background sound is needed.
If any issues occur when using recolor mods, or if layer errors are found pls let me know.
The decorating examples are from a friend. I don't know where the furniture came from, so please don't ask me.
